result.note: Tested the Strategic Partnership upgrade, the summit venue and the 2030 trade target from the July 2026 India–New Zealand visit.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to New Zealand in July 2026:
items: India and New Zealand elevated their ties to a Strategic Partnership.
The talks with Prime Minister Christopher Luxon were held in Wellington.
The two sides set a target to double bilateral trade to NZD 7 billion by 2030.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the ties were elevated in Auckland, not Wellington. It was the first Indian prime ministerial visit to New Zealand in 40 years and produced ten agreements.
questions.source: Modi and Christopher Luxon elevated India-New Zealand ties to a Strategic Partnership in Auckland, the first Indian prime ministerial visit in 40 years, with ten agreements and a target to double trade to NZD 7 billion (USD 4 billion) by 2030.
